info.title: Banking specification
info.description: The Banking API provides secure access to customer accounts, transactions, and financial data. It enables managing balances, transfers, and statements for a comprehensive banking experience. This API adheres to PCI-DSS, PSD2/Open Banking, and KYC/AML compliance requirements. All API interactions are logged for audit purposes, ensuring traceability and accountability. Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and timeout configurations are detailed in the accompanying API documentation, accessible via the support link.

x-logging-policy.description: All API requests and responses are logged for security, auditing, and debugging purposes. Sensitive data is masked.
x-logging-policy.details: Logs include request headers (excluding Authorization), request body (masked sensitive fields), response headers, response body (masked sensitive fields), timestamp, source IP, user agent, and X-Request-ID/X-Correlation-ID.

x-sla-policy.description: This API aims for a 99.9% uptime. Response times are typically under 500ms for read operations and 1000ms for write operations. Specific endpoint SLAs and timeout configurations are documented externally.

get.description: Checks the health and availability of the API. Returns a simple status to indicate if the service is operational.

status.description: Overall health status of the API.

503.description: Service Unavailable - API is currently unhealthy or undergoing maintenance.

error.message: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

post.description: Registers a new customer in the banking system. This endpoint initiates the Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) verification process. The initial `kycStatus` will typically be `PENDING`.

newCustomer.summary: Example of a new customer registration

201.description: Customer created successfully. KYC process initiated.

value.message: Customer created successfully. KYC verification is pending.

409.description: Conflict - Customer with provided email or phone already exists.

error.message: A customer with the provided email already exists.

get.description: Retrieves the detailed profile information for a specific customer, including their KYC status.
Retrieves a paginated list of all bank accounts associated with the authenticated customer. Includes account type, balance, and status.

200.description: A paginated list of customer accounts.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific bank account, identified by its unique `accountRef`.

parameters.name: accountRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the bank account.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of financial transactions associated with a specific bank account. Transactions can be filtered by type, status, and date range.

parameters.name: accountRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the bank account.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for filtering transactions (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2023-01-01').

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for filtering transactions (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2023-12-31').

200.description: A paginated list of transactions for the specified account.

post.description: Initiates a new financial transaction, such as a transfer between accounts or a bill payment. This endpoint supports idempotency via the `Idempotency-Key` header.

requestBody.description: Details for the transaction to be initiated.

201.description: Transaction initiated successfully. Status may be PENDING.

value.message: Transaction initiated successfully. Status is PENDING.

404.description: Not Found - Source or destination account not found.

409.description: Conflict - Insufficient funds or other business rule violation.

get.description: Retrieves the current status and full details of a specific financial transaction.

post.description: Initiates a new payment from a customer's account to a specified recipient. This endpoint typically requires Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) for compliance with regulations like PSD2. An `Idempotency-Key` header is required to prevent duplicate payments.

requestBody.description: Details for the payment to be initiated.

201.description: Payment initiated successfully. May require SCA.

value.message: Payment initiated successfully. Awaiting SCA confirmation.

404.description: Not Found - Source account not found.

409.description: Conflict - Insufficient funds or other business rule violation.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all debit and credit cards associated with the authenticated customer. Card numbers are masked for PCI-DSS compliance.

200.description: A paginated list of customer cards.

post.description: Blocks a specific card, preventing any further transactions. This action is typically irreversible or requires manual intervention to unblock. An `Idempotency-Key` header is required.

parameters.name: cardId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the card to be blocked.

lostCard.summary: Example of blocking a lost card

value.notes: Card reported lost by customer via phone.

409.description: Conflict - Card is already blocked or in an unblockable state.

error.message: Card 'card_mno345' is already in a BLOCKED state.

post.description: Creates a new consent for a customer, allowing third-party providers (TPP) to access specific account information or initiate payments on their behalf, in compliance with PSD2/Open Banking regulations. An `Idempotency-Key` header is required.

requestBody.description: Details for the consent to be created.

accountAccessConsent.summary: Example of an account access consent

404.description: Not Found - Customer or TPP not found.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific consent, including its scope, validity, and status.

delete.description: Revokes an existing consent, immediately terminating the associated third-party provider's access to customer data or payment initiation capabilities.

parameters.name: consentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the consent to be revoked.

204.description: Consent revoked successfully. No content returned.

409.description: Conflict - Consent is already revoked or expired.

error.message: Consent 'con_stu012' is already in a REVOKED state.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: A unique key to ensure that a request is processed only once. This is crucial for preventing duplicate transactions. It should be a UUID or similar unique string generated by the client.

XRequestIdRequestHeader.name: X-Request-ID
XRequestIdRequestHeader.description: A unique identifier for the request, generated by the client. Used for tracing and debugging across services.

XRequestIdResponseHeader.description: A unique identifier for the request, echoed back from the server. Useful for tracing and debugging.

XRateLimitLimitHeader.description: The maximum number of requests that the client can make in the current rate limit window.

XRateLimitRemainingHeader.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

XRateLimitResetHeader.description: The time at which the current rate limit window resets, specified in UTC epoch seconds.

scopes.accounts:read: Read customer account information (e.g., balance, type).
scopes.accounts:write: Manage customer accounts (e.g., open, close, update details).
scopes.payments:initiate: Initiate payments, potentially requiring Strong Customer Authentication (SCA).
scopes.cards:manage: Manage customer cards (e.g., block, unblock, activate).
scopes.customers:read: Read customer profile details (e.g., name, contact info, KYC status).
scopes.customers:write: Create or update customer profile details (e.g., address, phone).
scopes.consents:manage: Create, retrieve, and revoke PSD2/Open Banking consents.
